free_tier.stated: A Free plan exists: '10 GB of monthly traffic', 1 device, 5 locations, 128-bit encryption and no dedicated IP. Premium 1 year is listed at 'USD 3.39 /mo' and 'Billed $39.99 for 12 months' (against USD 9.99 a month); 1 month is $9.99 and 2 years is $59.99 for 27 months.
free_tier.notes: The free plan's traffic direction is not stated ('10 GB of monthly traffic'). The record is priced at the cheapest yearly Premium plan.

retention.stated: not applicable: a tunnel, not stored bytes

egress.terms: Premium: 'Unlimited traffic (bandwidth)'. Free: '10 GB of monthly traffic' with limited speed and possible congestion.
egress.free_allowance: free plan: 10 GB a month; Premium: unlimited

interface_detail: A tunnel and a proxy through apps (Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, FireTV, Linux and routers). Protocols in the vendor's table: WireGuard, IKEv2/IPSec, OpenVPN (UDP), OpenVPN (TCP), Shadow and ZoogTLS; the pricing page also names PPTP and L2TP/IPSec. UDP: yes, OpenVPN (UDP). Port forwarding: unverified: no page read states it. SOCKS5: yes, 'Several ZoogVPN servers allow you to connect using the SOCKS5 proxy technology.' Obfuscation: the Shadow protocol disguises VPN traffic as HTTPS. BitTorrent: allowed on servers marked 'P2P'; the terms say P2P is only permitted on those servers.
tooling: The vendor's apps, or OpenVPN, IKEv2 or WireGuard clients; SOCKS5 on selected servers.
chaining: A tunnel or SOCKS5 exit with a free 10 GB tier and an unlimited paid tier; the upstream sees a shared VPN address.

limits.value: free plan: 10 GB of monthly traffic; Premium: unlimited traffic
1 device on the free plan; up to 10 devices on Premium

limits_note: The device counts are filed under request-rate because the vocabulary has no concurrent-connection kind. P2P is limited to the servers marked P2P.
binding_note: On the free plan the 10 GB monthly traffic quota is what fails first for any bulk workload; Premium states unlimited traffic, so the quota does not bind on the paid tier this record is priced at.

identity_cost.detail: An email address and a password: 'you will need to provide your email address and password only for account management purposes'; the privacy notice says 'We only collect your email address (which can be a disposable one)'. The free plan needs a sign-up; no card is stated for it on the pages read.

reliability_note: The free plan is described by the vendor as one that 'may be interrupted or blocked', with limited speed and possible congestion.
confidence_note: Documented: price, free quota, protocols, UDP, SOCKS5, obfuscation, sign-up and BitTorrent lines are quoted from the vendor's own pages. Nothing was connected through the service. Port forwarding is unverified because no page read states it.
price_per_tb_month: USD 39.99 billed for 12 months; a subscription price, not a per-TB price
notes: Cheapest yearly price: 'Billed $39.99 for 12 months' on the pricing page. The 2-year plan is $59.99 for 27 months. A free plan with 10 GB a month is also offered.

evidence.proved: The free plan is capped at 10 GB a month.
